name: Jeffrey Zirlin personal wallet compromise
rootCause: On February 23, 2024, two personal wallet addresses belonging to Axie Infinity co-founder Jeffrey "Jihoz" Zirlin were compromised, resulting in the theft of approximately 3,248 ETH (about $9.7 million). The stolen funds were quickly laundered through Tornado Cash. The attack was limited to Zirlin's personal wallets and did not impact Ronin Network or Sky Mavis operations. The root cause was the compromise of private keys for two personal wallets controlled by Jeffrey Zirlin. The specific method of compromise has not been publicly disclosed.
